# Baseline Psychotherapy

> Premium online psychotherapy practice founded in New York in 2019, now based in Singapore and serving clients worldwide in English and Spanish. Founder: J.R. Hernandez, psychotherapist, burnout and mood disorders specialist. Evidence-based, process-based therapy for burnout, anxiety, depression, emotional regulation, couples, and expat life transitions.

Key facts: Focused Session $60 USD (30 min, one specific topic). Individual session $120 USD (60 min). Couples session $170 USD (90 min). Monthly plans: individual $430 USD, couples $620 USD. Burnout Recovery Program $1,200 USD (12 sessions). Sliding scale available case by case. Free 15-minute consultation. Sessions online via Google Meet, worldwide, in English and Spanish; in person in Yerevan, Armenia, by appointment and availability. Contact: WhatsApp +65 9372 9100, jr@baselinepsychotherapy.com. Rated 5.0 on Google Reviews (22 reviews).

Credentials of J.R. Hernandez (full profile: https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/about/): Professional Diploma in Psychotherapy, PDP (The School of Positive Psychology of Singapore); Medical Neuroscience (Duke University School of Medicine); Anxiety and Mood Disorders Specialization (American Psychological Association, APA); Integrative Medicine Specialization (University of Minnesota); Telehealth Specialization (Duke University); Master in Emotional Intelligence and Personal Development (Instituto de Estudios Psicológicos de España, ISEP); Master of Arts in International Psychology (The Chicago School of Professional Psychology).

## Services (English)

- [Burnout Therapy](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/burnout-therapy/): Structured recovery for professional burnout and chronic stress
- [Anxiety Therapy Online](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/anxiety-therapy-online/): Evidence-based treatment for anxiety and nervous system dysregulation
- [Depression Therapy Online](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/depression-therapy-online/): Treatment for depression and low drive
- [Emotional Regulation Therapy](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/emotional-regulation-therapy/): Training regulation as a clinical skill
- [Couples Therapy Online](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/couples-therapy-online/): Structured work on relationship distress and conflict cycles
- [Expat Therapy](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/expat-therapy/): Therapy for expats, relocation, and life transitions, by a therapist who has lived in six countries
- [Workplace Mental Health Training](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/workplace-mental-health-training/): Burnout prevention training for teams and organizations
- [About J.R. Hernandez](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/about/): Full professional background and credentials
- [Books by J.R. Hernandez](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/emotional-intelligence-books/): The Baseline Psychotherapy Protocol: A Process-Based Manual for Working With Your Own Reactions (2026), Emotional Intelligence & Behavioral Therapies, and Toto's Journey Through Emotions; paperback and Kindle, English and Spanish, on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/stores/JR-Hernandez/author/B0CZ9S1983
- [The Baseline Psychotherapy Protocol](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/method/): the working tool of this practice, created by psychotherapist J.R. Hernandez in clinical work and published as a process-based manual. A structured sequence for examining one reaction at a time that integrates cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), emotional intelligence training, and somatic awareness. Book on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/stores/JR-Hernandez/author/B0CZ9S1983
- [Pricing](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/pricing/): Transparent session fees and programs, from the 30-minute Focused Session ($60) to the 12-session Burnout Recovery Program
- [FAQ](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/faq/): Common questions about online therapy
- [Free Clinical Screeners](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/tests/): Free validated clinical screeners (PHQ-9, GAD-7, CBI, WHO-5, DASS-21, TMMS-24) in English and Spanish, private, browser-only
- [Interactive Regulation Tools](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/tests/breathing/): Guided breathing pacer and emotional meter, free and browser-only, in English and Spanish
- [Psychotherapist in Yerevan](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/yerevan/): Online and in-person sessions in Yerevan, Armenia, by appointment and availability, in English and Spanish

- [El Protocolo Baseline Psychotherapy](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/metodo/): la herramienta de trabajo de esta consulta, creada por el psicoterapeuta J.R. Hernandez en la práctica clínica y publicada como manual basado en procesos. Una secuencia estructurada para examinar una reacción a la vez que integra la terapia cognitivo-conductual (TCC), la terapia de aceptación y compromiso (ACT), el entrenamiento en inteligencia emocional y la conciencia somática. Libro en Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/stores/JR-Hernandez/author/B0CZ9S1983
- [Formación en Salud Mental Laboral](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/formacion-salud-mental-laboral/)
- [Precios](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/precios/): Desde la Sesión Focal de 30 minutos ($60) hasta el Programa de Recuperación de Burnout de 12 sesiones
- [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/preguntas-frecuentes/)
- [Tests Clínicos Gratuitos](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/tests/): Seis screeners validados (PHQ-9, GAD-7, CBI, WHO-5, DASS-21, TMMS-24), privados, solo en el navegador
- [Herramientas de Regulación](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/tests/respiracion/): Respiración guiada y medidor emocional, gratis y solo en el navegador
- [Psicoterapeuta en Ereván](https://baselinepsychotherapy.com/es/yerevan/): Sesiones online y presenciales en Ereván, Armenia, con cita previa y según disponibilidad
